name: LOVE BLOOMS: Speed Dating with Persephone
source:
"The flowers will bloom again once love blooms in me, she says."

Persephone is the Goddess of Spring … yet Winter has made its way into her heart.

Aphrodite's solution? 

Speed dating, of course!

Amongst all these mythological singles, will Persephone's true love emerge to thaw her frozen heart?
